note: Integration input only. Foundation records this contract without implementing or executing any scenario below; workspace transactions own commit, recovery, and replay. No test in foundation executes these scenarios.

rules: The fields above equal the published schema's required MutationPlan set; idempotencyKey is optional on the wire but bound into the plan digest whenever present.
The transaction re-reads and rechecks every field immediately before applying; a newly computed plan cannot inherit an earlier approval.
The recorded plan digest must verify (recompute-and-compare) before authorization is consulted.
Same idempotency key plus identical content returns the recorded result; same key plus changed content is a conflict.
A crash or timeout after prepare but before an observable commit returns recovery-required with the prepared transaction, never a guessed success.

policyPrecedence.note: Repository prose and work-local metadata never replace required organization policy; approval and exception authority require a trusted boundary.

rules: Exceptions are typed records, not owner text plus a Boolean.
Expired or revoked exceptions fail closed; removal and expiry are explicit lifecycle facts, not silent deletion.

gitProvenance.note: Commit/tree/status observations may accompany a transaction as provenance only; they never substitute for work revision or dirty-snapshot identity.

scenarioInventory.name: same-key identical replay returns the recorded result
same-key changed content is a conflict
stale expected revision is a conflict
changed workflow definition invalidates prior approval
scenarioInventory.expected: re-approval required; old receipt stays immutable
